senses.gloss:
षोढा ind. In six ways.
--Comp.
--न्यासः the six ways of
touching the body with mystical
texts.
--मुखः ‘six-faced’, N. of
Kārtikeya; द्रोढा जनोर्जनितषोढामुखः
समिति वोढा स हाटकगिरेः Aśvad. 7.

सोढ p. p. [सह्-क्त इडभावः]
[]
Borne, suffered, endured, put up
with &c.; see सह्.

सोढृ a. (ढ्री f.) [सह्-तृच्]
1
Enduring, bearing, patient.
--2
Powerful, able.
